column1: # Shared vectors for the shell-drawn renderer's colour -> SGR parameter map,
# which must emit the codes the agent's style encoder emits
# Fish draws with its builtin `set_color`, so it has no copy of this map.
# Format: one vector per line, tab-separated: color<TAB>fg<TAB>bg, where fg/bg
# are the SGR parameters for `__gpy_sgr_param fg|bg COLOR`. Blank lines and
# comment lines are ignored; since a colour can start with `#`, a comment is
# a line that is exactly `#` or starts with `# ` (hash, space). The
# whole-column token \e means the EMPTY string; everything else is literal.
# Every reader MUST fail if this file is missing or yields no vectors.
# Contract: named colours and their bright forms map to 30-37/90-97 (fg) and
# `normal`, `default`, empty, out-of-range, malformed -- to the terminal
